hero.heading: Your apps, one command each.
hero.lead: Curated templates that set up storage, a database, HTTPS on a .crust.internal name and backups for you. Every app runs in its own microVM unless it needs more.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Search apps, e.g. photos, dns, git

list.label: Apps
list.empty: No apps in the catalog yet. Templates are written in the open on GitHub.

teaser.heading: Know what you're installing.
teaser.lead: Every app page shows what it needs, what it creates and how it's isolated, before you click install.
teaser.about: Self-hosted photo and video backup with automatic phone uploads, face recognition and smart search.

how.heading: Compose-based templates, curated in the open.

items.title: Compose underneath
items.body: Templates are Compose files plus a small Crustates section for storage, databases, names and backups.

items.title: Import what you have
items.body: Bring any compose.yaml, or import from existing catalogs. Crustates maps it to apps and volumes.

items.title: Update with rollback
items.body: New versions show up in the console. Updates snapshot the app first, so you can roll back.

items.title: Reviewed and signed
items.body: Curated templates are reviewed on GitHub and signed. Community templates are clearly marked.

submit.heading: Missing an app? Submit it.
submit.lead: Open a pull request with a template, or ask for one in the community.

app.versionsNote: Crustates checks for new versions daily and updates with a snapshot first, so you can roll back.
